pages.title: Noren Curtains
pages.text: Noren are the split curtains that hang in doorways. Four patterns exist — plain, striped, wavy and long — in all 16 wool colors.

pages.title: Lanterns
pages.text: Four paper lanterns, red and white, plain or lettered, each bright enough on its own to light a whole room.

pages.title: Stone Lantern
pages.text: A garden lantern cut from stone, two blocks tall. It is solid stone all the way through, so it gives out no light of its own.

pages.title: Wrought Iron Railings
pages.text: Blackened ironwork, which lends a room some weight.

pages.title: Paper Goods
pages.text: Two paper-made building blocks, each in a solid and a thin pane form.

pages.title: Plank Walls
pages.text: Plank walls come in every wood type

pages.title: Tiles
pages.text: Tiles come in seven colors: cyan, orange, yellow, brown, blue, black and gray. Every color has stairs, slabs and wall panels.

pages.title: Ice Bricks
pages.text: Thematic bricks made from packed ice, with stairs, slabs and vertical slabs. Suitable for snowy environments.
